toleranceRegression.sourceRef: world_lab/geo02/source_excerpt/graph.ts :: SNAP_TOL=7, Idx.key, addEdge(a===b) return; geom.ts :: resample(...,8)
toleranceRegression.explanation: At tol=8 exactly-8 au resample steps merge into one node, so addEdge(a===b) drops road edges. GEO-01 joinToleranceAu=8 defects are NOT preserved; tol=7 is used for every conclusion below.

isolatedNodeInflation.note: Idx.key inserts every sample into all five graphs; components over active edges are the meaningful transport network.

failures.expected: Derived graph uses the Editor SNAP_TOL=7.
failures.actual: GEO-01 used joinToleranceAu=8; at tol=8 the 1318 road samples merge into 822 nodes and 596 foot edges self-drop, versus 81 at tol=7.
failures.proposal: Use tol=7 for all transport conclusions; retain tol=8 only as a documented regression.

failures.expected: A POI with cart logistics is within Editor ACCESS_R=48 au of a cart road.
failures.actual: nearest cart road rd_n at 56.8792 au; nearest foot/trail rd_16 at 0 au.
failures.proposal: PROPOSED cart connector centreline + measurable surface width, OR retain po_kilns as foot-access-only. Both preserved as alternatives; macro geography unchanged.

failures.expected: A cart-classified road crosses on a cart-load bridge with measured deck and clearance.
failures.actual: br_a load=foot; foot-only bridge blocks the cart edge. Road width, deck span and swept clearance are UNDEFINED.
failures.proposal: Author PROPOSED deck polygon from the measured raster chord; keep cartPassable=false until swept clearance is evidenced.

failures.expected: A bridge approach has a measured swept-clearance envelope.
failures.actual: clearanceCells=0 at cell 20341 / [732,652]; road width, channel width, deck span and cart footprint UNDEFINED.
failures.proposal: Author PROPOSED deck span/width and road/river physical widths, then validate. Until then clearance stays UNKNOWN; no cart-passable RT-1 claim.
